name: Bird
description: Base lies on back with feet up, supporting flyer's hips. Flyer balances horizontally face-down. Hands are free.

name: Straddle Throne
description: Base feet on Flyer thighs. Flyer sits with wide legs, Feet around Base shins. Facing each other.

name: Reverse Straddle Throne
description: Base feet on Flyer thighs. Flyer sits with wide legs, Feet around Base shins, facing away from Base head.

name: Front Plank
description: Base lies on back with feet up, supporting flyer's hips. Flyer balances horizontally face-down. Hands connected for support.

name: Shoulder Stand
description: Base lies on back supporting flyer's shoulders with hands, flyer is upside down, facing towards base feet. Base Hands (including thumbs) on flyer's back/shoulders. Base sees flyer back.

name: Reverse Shoulder Stand
description: Base lies on back supporting flyer's shoulders with hands, flyer is upside down facing towards base head. Base thumbs on flyer's back. Base sees flyer front.

name: Star
description: Flyer does a shoulderstand on Base feet. Hands connected in "stargrip". Base straight arms, Flyer bent arms.

name: Folded Leaf
description: Base's feet on flyer's hips. Flyer folds forward, Flyer head on Base belly.

name: Chair
description: Flyer sits with butt on Base feet like on a chair. Base holds Flyer feet.

name: Extended Reverse F2H
description: Like Reverse F2H, just straight Base arms.

name: Whale
description: Flyer lays on Base feet with their shoulderblades, arches slightly backwards, watches ceiling. Base holds Flyers lower legs in hands.

name: Vishnu's Couch (Left)
description: Flyer lays sideways: Base left foot in Flyer right armpit, Base right foot between Flyer legs, on Flyer left thigh. Flyer can raise left arm upwards, and use right arm to hold on Base left leg for stability.

name: Vishnu's Couch (Right)
description: Flyer lays sideways: Base right foot in Flyer left armpit, Base left foot between Flyer legs, on Flyer right thigh. Flyer can raise right arm upwards, and use left arm to hold on Base right leg for stability.

name: Straddlebat
description: Like star, but lower donw: Instead of Base feet on Flyer shoulders, they are on the outer thighs. Flyer head almost on Base belly.

name: Floating Paschi
description: Flyer in triangle form: grabbing their own ankles, and upside down. Base grabs the Flyer's upper arms, balances whole weight with their arms.

name: Reverse Bird
description: Like Bird, but Flyer faces the other way. Base feet still on Flyer hips. Connecting hands optional, but requires long straight arms.

name: Side Star (Left)
description: Bases left leg on Flyer left hip. Flyer leans inward, from base perspective to right. Both hands connected.

name: Side Star (Right)
description: Bases right leg on Flyer right hip. Flyer leans inward, from base perspective to left. Both hands connected.

name: Mono Reverse Shin-to-Foot +Hands (Left)
description: From star, Flyer lower left knee, and Base removes their left Foot from Flyer should and places it onto the Flyer shin.

name: Mono Reverse Shin-to-Foot +Hands (Right)
description: From star, Flyer lower right knee, and Base removes their right Foot from Flyer should and places it onto the Flyer shin.

name: Supported Mono Kneepit (Left)
description: Base left foot in Flyer left kneepit. The other Foot+Shin can stay together. Both straight arms connected and stacked.

name: Supported Mono Kneepit (Right)
description: Base right foot in Flyer right kneepit. The other Foot+Shin can stay together. Both straight arms connected and stacked.

name: Mono Backbird (Left)
description: Base left foot on Flyer sacrum, toes pointing outwards (left). Hands still connected, can rotate outwards towards star grip.

name: Mono Backbird (Right)
description: Base right foot on Flyer sacrum, toes pointing outwards (right). Hands still connected, can rotate outwards towards star grip.

name: Back Bird
description: Like Bird, but Flyer turns to face the ceiling. Base Feet on Flyer butt. Hand connection optional.

name: Low F2H
description: Base elbows close to chest, Flyer faces away, heels at Base fingers and toes at Base wrist. High-Heels!

name: Low Reverse F2H
description: Base elbows close to chest. Flyer facing towards Base head. C-grip for Base. No High-Heels!

name: Reverse Chair
description: Like Chair, but facing away. Flyer feet dangling or put on Base calves.

name: Foot to Shin
description: Base tucked, Flyer stands on shins, facing Base head.

name: Reverse Back Bird
description: Almost like whale, but centered: Base feet on Flyer butt. Flyer facing the ceiling, head away from Base head.

name: Iron cross
description: Flyer in T-pose (push down with arms!), piked legs. Base feet in Flyer armpits. Base hands support Flyer legs.

name: Extended F2H
description: Base straight arms, Flyer faces away, heels at Base fingers and toes at Base wrist. High-Heels!

name: Two High
description: Base standing, Flyer on shoulders, Base holding back of Flyer kneepits/calves donw

name: Galionsfigur
description: Base standing slightly squatting, Flyer standing on Base knees looking away. Base holding Flyer's hips, leaning back. Counterbalance

name: Standing Counterbalance
description: Base slightly squatting, Flyer standing on knees, facing each other. Both holding wrists with long arms, leaning back

name: Standing Flag (Left)
description: Base slightly squatting, Flyer standing with their left Foot on both Base knees, Flyer right foot behind Base neck. Base left arm can hold Flyer right leg.

name: Standing Flag (Right)
description: Base slightly squatting, Flyer standing with their right Foot on both Base knees, Flyer left foot behind Base neck. Base right arm can hold Flyer left leg.

name: Standing on Hips
description: Base in wide squat, Flyer behind, with feet close to Base hips on upper legs

name: Flyer standing on Knees
description: Base on ground, feet close to butt, knees up. Flyer standing on knees. Base can support Flyer shins with hands.

name: L-Sit
description: Base on floor, arms straight up. Flyer pushes with arms down. Fingers opposed, Flyer looks towards Base feet.

name: Reverse L-Sit
description: Base on floor, arms straight up. Flyer pushes with arms down. Fingers aligned, Flyer looks towards Base head.

name: Back on Shins
description: L-Base, tucked. Flyer back on Base shins, head between Base feet. Flyer butt overhanging Base knees. Hands connected.

name: Out: Flyer Tucked Before Base
description: Flyer on ground, tucked. Base standing. Flyer feet on Base knees. Base can grab Flyer knees.

name: Sitting on Shoulders
description: Like carrying your small child though the zoo :)

name: Bird on Hands
description: Base grabs Flyer hips: 2 fingers on belly, 2 on outside, hip bones in palm.

name: Extended H2H
description: L-Base, but straight long arms handstand. Hands are gripping opposed, Flyer facing Base head.

name: Extended Reverse H2H
description: Hands gripping with aligned fingers, Flyer faces Base feet.

name: Reverse Star
description: Like star, but Flyer facing away. Base arms straight and pushing upwards, Flyer arms also almost straight.

name: Outside Sidestar (Left)
description: Flyer on left Base leg, head towards left.

name: Outside Sidestar (Right)
description: Flyer on right Base leg, head towards right.

name: Front plank twisted hands (left)
description: Prepare to twist into a star, Base left hand up

name: Front plank twisted hands (right)
description: Prepare to twist into a star, Base right hand up

name: Cross-legged Straddlebat (left)
description: Like Straddlebat, but base has X-legs, and the left knee is on Flyers back, and right Base leg behind.

name: Cross-legged Straddlebat (right)
description: Like Straddlebat, but base has X-legs, and the right knee is on Flyers back, and left Base leg behind.

name: Folded Leaf tucked through
description: Like folded leaf, but the Flyer put their upper body through the Base legs and rests their back on the underside of the Base legs.

name: Standing on Flyer Legs
description: Flyer lies on floor on belly. Base stands on upper legs of Flyer. Flyer can hook their feet on Base shins. Base grab Flyer hands and lean squat down into L-Basing.

name: L-Sit with outside legs
description: L-Sit, but Flyer straddles and has arms inside the legs

name: Standing behind counterbalance
description: Base stands behind Flyer, both hold hands, counterbalance leaning away from each other

name: Reverse Vishnus Couch (Left)
description: Flyer lays sideways, facing away from base head: Base left foot in Flyer left armpit, Base right foot between Flyer legs, on Flyer right thigh. Flyer can raise right arm upwards, and use left arm to hold on Base left leg for stability.

name: Reverse Vishnus Couch (Right)
description: Flyer lays sideways, facing away from base head: Base right foot in Flyer right armpit, Base left foot between Flyer legs, on Flyer left thigh. Flyer can raise left arm upwards, and use right arm to hold on Base right leg for stability.

name: Out: L-Base, Flyer at Feet (Facing In)
description: Both safely on the ground. Base lies on back with legs up or relaxed. Flyer stands at base's feet end, facing toward base's head. Classic entry position for bird, front plank, throne.

name: Out: L-Base, Flyer at Feet (Facing Out)
description: Both safely on the ground. Base lies on back with legs up or relaxed. Flyer stands at base's feet end, facing away from base. Entry position for whale, reverse back bird, reverse chair.

name: Out: L-Base, Flyer at Head (Facing In)
description: Both safely on the ground. Base lies on back. Flyer stands at base's head end, facing toward base's feet (straddling base's head).

name: Out: L-Base, Flyer at Head (Facing Out)
description: Both safely on the ground. Base lies on back. Flyer stands at base's head end, facing away from base. Entry for reverse shoulder stand.

name: Out: Standing, Facing Each Other
description: Both safely on the ground, standing and facing each other. Entry/exit for most standing poses like standing counterbalance, flyer on knees.

name: Out: Standing, Base Behind Flyer
description: Both safely on the ground, standing in the same direction with base behind the flyer. Entry/exit for standing-behind counterbalance, two-high, sitting on shoulders.

name: Out: Standing, Flyer Behind Base
description: Both safely on the ground, standing in the same direction with flyer behind the base. Entry/exit for galionsfigur, standing on hips.

name: Out: Standing, Back-To-Back
description: Both safely on the ground, standing back-to-back facing opposite directions.

name: Out: Sidestar Entry (Left)
description: Both safely on the ground. Base lies on back, flyer stands to the base's left side at hip level. Entry position for left sidestar.

name: Out: Sidestar Entry (Right)
description: Both safely on the ground. Base lies on back, flyer stands to the base's right side at hip level. Entry position for right sidestar.

name: Flyer Handstand Behind Base
description: Base standing upright. Flyer does a handstand directly behind base, back-to-back. Base reaches back and grabs flyer's ankles.

name: Low H2H
description: L-Base, Base elbows close to chest. Hands are gripping opposed, Flyer doing handstand facing Base head.

name: Low Reverse H2H
description: L-Base, Base elbows close to chest. Hands gripping with aligned fingers. Flyer doing handstand facing Base feet.
